title: Kubernetes Certs (CKA · CKAD · CKS)
blurb: Hands-on prep for the three CNCF Kubernetes exams: kubectl speed, then a CKA track (kubeadm, RBAC, Helm/Kustomize, Gateway API, storage, troubleshooting), a CKAD track (app design, deployment strategies, probes, security contexts) and a CKS track (CIS hardening, AppArmor/seccomp, Pod Security, supply chain, Falco and audit logs).
interviewIntro: Exam-shaped tasks with worked solutions, grouped by exam. Read the task, do it on a practice cluster (kind, minikube, or a kubeadm lab), then reveal the solution and compare — especially the verification step. Every solution ends the way the grader checks: is the object in the right namespace, on the right host, in the state the task described?
